Title: Azure SQL—Public preview updates for mid-March 2022

Body.Content:
Azure SQL—Public preview updates for mid-March 2022

In mid-March 2022, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • The link feature for Azure SQL Managed Instance reimagines the connection and near real-time database replication between SQL Server and SQL Managed Instance.
  • Send advance notifications up to 24 hours before planned events with Azure SQL Managed instance.
  • Exchange Service Broker messages between Azure SQL Managed Instance and SQL Server anywhere.
  • Perform import and export using private endpoints in Azure SQL Database.
